title: Scalable Fabrication of 3D Optical Re-distribution for Co-Packaged Optics using an Developed Nanoimprint Stepper
orgs: National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology (AIST)
notes: UV imprint stepper: four 40 mm mirrors on 75 mm substrate in one shot (angle sigma 0.736 deg); imprinted top mirror on SiPh die, 14.2 dB fiber-to-fiber IL, 112G PAM4 TDECQ 1.5 dB.

title: Collective die-to-wafer assembly process for optically interconnected System-on-wafer
notes: imec CoD2W dielectric bonding of 7.2 mm, 100 um SiN-waveguide PIC dies onto 300 mm optical interconnect wafer; carrier-adhesion fix raises transfer yield 74% to 96%, 2.4 um m+3s, EVC loss <0.5 dB.

title: Wafer-On-Wafer-On-Wafer (WoWoW) Integration Having Large-scale High Reliability Fine 1 um Pitch Face-To-Back (F2B) Cu-Cu Connections and Fine 6 um Pitch TSVs
notes: Three-wafer stack: 1 um pitch F2F and F2B Cu-Cu hybrid bonds, via-last 6 um pitch TSVs in 3 um middle Si; 50k-link chains 100% yield; SIV 175 C 1000 h; TDDB.

title: Electrical Characterization and Reliability Studies of Nano-TSV

notes: 12-inch SOI (75 nm Si, 2000 A BOX) fusion-bonded to Si carrier; 180 x 500 nm nano-TSV, Al2O3/Ta/Cu/ECP Cu, Al FS/BS metal; warpage per step, chain R and leakage before/after TC, HTS, uHAST.
